theBatchWasHELDUntilAcPowerWasConnected.statement: The live window did not open when the batch was otherwise ready. The host was on BATTERY, and AC power is a required precondition. Execution was stopped before the first live request and resumed only after AC power was confirmed.
theBatchWasHELDUntilAcPowerWasConnected.whyThisMattered: This host performs a maintenance sleep roughly every two hours even on AC, and had slept on battery 14 minutes before the window would have opened. F5 was lost to a host sleep whose symptoms were indistinguishable from institution latency, so the precondition was treated as binding rather than advisory.

perSelectionIndex.whatHappened: The robots.txt request answered 301. The gateway never follows a redirect, robots.txt included, so the site policy was genuinely unread and the root terminated as ROBOTS_UNREADABLE_ROOT before any institution content was requested. The 3xx was recorded as a redirect observation, which is a fact, not a promotion.

whatThisBatchDoesNotConclude.noSd9VerdictIsReachedHere: SD9 may only be decided after SD7 near-duplicate deduplication, and SD7 is not authorised in this batch. Both started organisations remain ACQUISITION_STATUS_PENDING_SD7 even though a zero-page organisation cannot mechanically reach four pages.
whatThisBatchDoesNotConclude.noPopulationEstimateIsDrawn: Two organisations is far too small a sample to revise the corpus plan, and the combined Batch-01 plus Batch-02 picture is not a population estimate either.
whatThisBatchDoesNotConclude.theRobotsOutcomesAreNotAJudgementAboutTh: ROBOTS_UNREADABLE_ROOT records that this vantage could not read a site policy - once because of a 301 that is never followed, once because of a TLS failure. It is a statement about the request from this vantage, not about the institution.

observationForTheOwner.cumulativeZeroYieldAcrossBothBatches: Batch 01 recorded 3 of 5 organisations with zero raw page evidence; Batch 02 recorded 2 of 2. Seven live organisations have now been acquired in total and five of them produced no page evidence at all.
observationForTheOwner.whetherThisIsASamplingEffectAVantageEffe: Batch 02's two terminations were a robots.txt 301 and a robots.txt TLS failure - neither is a robots DISALLOW. Deciding what that means is an owner question and is deliberately not answered here.
observationForTheOwner.p2RobotsAnomalyAssessment: P2's frozen pilot rule asks for three consecutive ROBOTS_BLOCKED_ROOT / ROBOTS_UNREADABLE_ROOT outcomes, or more than 40% of the completed organisations. Two consecutive were observed, which is below the consecutive threshold; the percentage limb is reported rather than applied, because P5 stopped the batch first and a 2-organisation denominator cannot support it. This is surfaced for owner review, not adjudicated here.
